scenes.text: People walk in. They look around. Then… they leave. For Leo, it's becoming a familiar story. He runs a furniture shop in a busy neighborhood. The products are ready. The customers are out there. But after days of trying to bring them back, he's still guessing. Who should he reach? And what should he offer? The clues are already there, in what shoppers browse, what they ask about, and what they buy. Leo just needs a way to connect them.

scenes.text: First, we give the agent a map. That's our ontology. It connects shoppers, products, interactions, and payments into one understandable story. It keeps a product recommendation separate from a general inquiry, and makes sure one purchase isn't counted twice. Now the agent has a clearer picture of what happened, which examples to learn from, and who might be ready to return.
